no_coverage_with_closest: Closest static answer in your packs is below.
maps_gap: No maps pack on device. Static safety packs cover EN/ZH/AR. Import a maps pack from Settings.
pack_language_gap: No pack in {{language}}. Active packs: {{languages}}. Ask in any of those, or import a {{language}} pack.
model_not_loaded: No model loaded. Open Models, then load Gemma 4 E2B.
geo_handoff_maps_gap: No maps pack on device. Static safety packs cover EN/ZH/AR. Import a maps pack from Settings.
geo_gps_unavailable: GPS unavailable in airplane mode. Re-enable location, then ask again.
answer_without_source_body: The model will reply without grounding in your packs. Verify the answer before acting.
web_only_message: Build or open the native app to verify LiteRT, perception, model storage, and other on-device features. Web and Expo Go cannot run these native OfflineAid capabilities.
runtime_gate_feature_specific: {{featureName}} is only available in the native app. Build or open the native app to verify LiteRT, perception, model storage, and other on-device features. Web and Expo Go cannot run these native OfflineAid capabilities.
speech_unavailable_ios: Voice input is unavailable. Enable Siri & Dictation in iOS Settings, then try again.
speech_unavailable_android: Voice input is unavailable. Install or enable a system speech-recognition service, then try again.
speech_not_allowed: Microphone or speech-recognition permission was denied. Enable it in system settings to use voice input.
speech_lang_not_supported: Offline speech recognition is not ready for {{locale}} on this device yet. Download the on-device language pack, then try again.
speech_network: This recognizer tried to use the network. OfflineAid only accepts on-device speech recognition for voice input.
speech_no_speech: No speech was detected. Try again and speak after the mic starts listening.
speech_audio_capture: OfflineAid could not access the microphone. Check system permissions and any other app using audio.
speech_aborted: Voice input was cancelled. Tap the mic again to restart.
speech_default: Offline voice input could not continue.
speech_web_only: Offline voice input is only available in the iOS and Android app builds.
speech_no_on_device: This device does not offer on-device speech recognition, so OfflineAid cannot keep voice input fully offline here.
speech_could_not_start: Offline voice input could not start.
speech_download_opened: Android opened the offline speech-model download for {{locale}}. Finish that download, then tap the mic again.
speech_download_cancelled: Offline speech-model download for {{locale}} was cancelled. Try the mic again when you're ready.
closest_collapse_a11y: Collapse closest match in your packs
closest_expand_a11y: Expand closest match in your packs
